title: That city was not for me
author: Boby Borah
text:
That city was not for me
That city I left Was not mine.
When I stepped in its Long entrance
I didn`t get fragrance of flowers In that garden;
That city was not for me.
That city`s tall buildings
The small street`s Were unknown for me,
The screams floated from its room
Loaded heavy stones over tiny heart,
That city was not for me. When
I got in rept in the sticky rains,
When the splashes enmeshed around,
Then recess to think,
That odd time rain didn`t come for me;
That city was not for me. The city`s lanes
The petals of roses
The smile of peacock flower`s
Fitted in my bosom`s folds,
While walking thereon
The scent of existence
Touched me in fickleness,
Despite why!
That city was not for me.
